name: Initial credit screening paper
purpose: A short first look at a new opportunity, to decide whether it is worth spending time and diligence budget on.
use_when: A new borrower or deal at first approach: information is indicative (teaser, IM, management presentation, desktop valuation), no diligence has been done and there is no term sheet. The question is whether to proceed to diligence.

name: Investment Committee credit paper
purpose: The full credit approval paper for a new facility, taken to the Investment Committee.
use_when: A new facility where diligence is complete: independent valuation, financial or QS due diligence and an indicative term sheet with covenants and conditions precedent. The question is whether to approve the facility.

name: Credit variation paper
purpose: Approval of a change to an existing Quillwood facility: extension, upsize, covenant reset, waiver or amendment.
use_when: The borrower already has a facility with Quillwood and asks to change it. Sources are the existing facility summary, a request letter, compliance certificates and performance reports. The question is whether to agree the change, and on what conditions.
